name: HEGRUS Electric Octo-pus Claw Head Scalp Massager 3 Modes Vib-ration Massage The-rapeutic Head Scra-tcher Relief Head Fatigue Improve Sleep Octo-pus Head Vib-ration Relaxing Massager
description:
Relieve Fatigue: Uses TMS massage principle to effectively reduce head fatigue, stress, dizziness, insomnia, brain fatigue, and hair loss while promoting relaxation and better sleep

3 Massage Modes: Offers three vibration modes for customized comfort, delivering a SPA-like experience anytime, anywhere

Ergonomic Design: Octopus-shaped design fits the natural curve of the head, comfortable to wear, and easy to fix

One-Key Operation: Simple top switch to turn on/off and switch modes, user-friendly even for the elderly

Specifications:

Type: Head Massager

Material: ABS + Silicone

Battery Capacity: 1100mAh

Working Time: Up to 480 minutes

Modes: 3

Color: Black

Size: 15 × 12 cm

Description:
Enjoy a relaxing scalp massage with this ergonomically designed octopus head massager. Lightweight, portable, and easy to use, it stimulates the scalp, reduces stress, and helps improve sleep quality. Perfect for home, office, or travel, this massager brings comfort and wellness to your daily routine.
